title: Mass scaling of blow-ups: M_{η(W)}(η_{x,λ#}T) = λ^{−n}M_W(T)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, η = η_{x,λ}, and let W ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary. Then M_{η(W)}(η_{x,λ#}T) = ofReal(λ^{−n})·M_W(T) in [0,∞], where M_W(Y) is the supremum of ofReal(Y(ω)) over test forms ω in the domain of Y with tsupport ω ⊆ W and Euclidean coefficient norm ≤ 1 everywhere (SimonGMT massOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (W : Set (Euclid P)), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').massOn (dilation x lam '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * T.massOn W
